notes.title: 1976 - Update 6
notes.content: Celebrating the launch of the game on the official Oculus Quest AppLab platform we have added new languages to 1976 Back to midway: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, and Catalan

notes.title: Minor improvements
notes.content: Small graphic improvements, a new message advising to play seated, and other small improvements or bug fixes.

notes.title: Oculus Quest version of 1976 Back to midway Demo available
notes.content:
We have published a FREE demo for Oculus Quest of this game in sideQuest: 
https://sidequestvr.com/app/2854/1976-back-to-midway-demo

The game is now available on Steam and the Oculus Rift store. We are still waiting to see if one-day Oculus permits us to publish in the official Quest store.

notes.title: 1976 - Update 5
notes.content:
- New languages: Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
- Improved the game UI: Now you can also check the progress of the 3 missions on the big screen.
- Improved the information shown to the player when you pause.
- Fixed the problem with the controls of the vive cosmos.
- Improved the sensitivity of VR controls in immersion zones.
- Auto-snap with VR controls takes into account the player's predominant hand as preference.
- Some bug fixes and performance improvements.

notes.title: 1976 - Update 4
notes.content:
- Integration of LIV for mixed reality videos.
- Improved control customization system to ensure customization is saved correctly.
- Other improvements and correction of minor errors.

notes.title: 1976 - Update 3
notes.content:
- New method of mixed control uses the stick of the controller for the arcade and the hand's movement for the immersion zones.
- New binding system that supports classic controls using binary buttons instead of an axis.
- Lighting adjustments in some scenes for better visibility.
- Other improvements and correction of minor errors.
Thank you very much for the tremendous constructive feedback we receive to provide an even better gaming experience.

notes.title: 1976 - Update 2
notes.content:
- New screen to be able to consult all the records in a centralized way.
- Improved the graphic quality of the menus by increasing the resolution of the cinema screen.
- Minor improvements and some bugs fixed.

notes.title: 1976 - Update 1
notes.content:
- Improved support for all types of joystick Hotas: 
Native support for some models like Thrustmaster Hotas Warthog and Thrustmaster t.flight Hotas and entering the binding section for any other joystick model.
- Improvement of the workshop with a description of each upgrade.
- New option in controls to be able to invert the vertical axis in the immersion zones.
- Improved some sound effects and music settings.
- Fixed problem with slow time power-up using an external controller.
